faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Zakir Husain Delhi College Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Zakir Husain Delhi College Assistant Professor positions is 28th August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies for the Assistant Professor post announced by Zakir Husain Delhi College in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Assistant Professor role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with at least 55% marks in the relevant subject, along with a NET qualification or a Ph.D. as per UGC Regulations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary as per Academic Pay Level 10 (7th CPC) along with usual allowances as admissible by the government.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for UR category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for candidates belonging to the Unreserved (UR) category is Rs. 1000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Are there any relaxations in the application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates belonging to the SC/ST/PwBD categories are required to pay a reduced application fee of Rs. 600/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves screening based on academic scores, followed by a Presentation Assessment, and finally an Interview conducted by a Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, applications for the Zakir Husain Delhi College Assistant Professor recruitment must be submitted strictly through the online mode.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of Zakir Husain Delhi College?
faq.answer: The official website of Zakir Husain Delhi College is https://zhdce.ac.in/. Candidates can visit this site for more information and updates.

faq.question: Q10. What is the Advt No. for this Zakir Husain Delhi College recruitment?
faq.answer: The Advertisement Number for this Zakir Husain Delhi College recruitment is ZHDCE/TS/02/2026.
